An '''individual''' served as the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] of the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Gorgos]], a member of the ruling [[Dark Council]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Codex" /> Sometime after [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' places the end of the [[Great Galactic War]] in [[3653 BBY]].</ref> Darth Gorgos ordered the construction the [[Spires of Victory]], a sculpture in [[Kaas City]]<ref name="Codex" /> on the Empire's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]],<ref name="DK">{{TORcite|type=codex|Dromund Kaas}}</ref> in celebration of the Empire's victory over the Republic during the [[Great Galactic War]]. Gorgos's apprentice [[Death/Legends|killed]] the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] before the Spires's completion, although Gorgos's successor on the Dark Council oversaw the completion of the monument.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Gorgos's apprentice was mentioned in the Codex entry for the Spires of Victory in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
